blocks.text: Seller represents and warrants to Buyer that:

items: Seller is the legal owner of the Vehicle and has the right to sell it to Buyer.
The Vehicle is free of all liens and encumbrances, except as disclosed above. Seller will provide a lien release or evidence of lien satisfaction, if applicable.
The title is authentic, valid, and free of all liens (or Seller will provide a bonded title, court-ordered title, or other method of establishing ownership, as applicable).
Seller has disclosed to Buyer all known damage, defects, missing parts, and other issues with the Vehicle.
The Vehicle has not been reported stolen and is not subject to any repossession, upset lien, or other legal claim.
Seller has not made any promises or guarantees about the Vehicle's condition, operability, or roadworthiness, except as expressly stated in this Agreement.
The Vehicle is sold "as is, where is" and without any warranty, express or implied, including any warranty of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose.
Seller has not concealed any damage, defects, or other issues with the Vehicle.
Buyer has inspected the Vehicle (or has had the Vehicle inspected by a third party) and is satisfied with its condition.
Buyer understands that the Vehicle is sold "as is, where is" and without any warranty.

Buyer has had the opportunity to test-drive, inspect, or have the Vehicle inspected by a mechanic, if the Vehicle is operable. If the Vehicle is not operable, Buyer acknowledges that Buyer has not test-driven the Vehicle.
Buyer is responsible for all transfer fees, taxes, registration fees, and other costs associated with taking ownership of the Vehicle.
Buyer is responsible for securing a title, registration, and any other required documentation for the Vehicle after purchase.
Buyer assumes all risks associated with the Vehicle after the date of sale.
